propositions: Four bound-exceeded firings on 2026-08-12 missed DEPLOY_DEFER_MAX (1800s) by 10–130s (deferred_for: 1810s, 1820s, 1810s, 1930s), each killing an in-flight LLM-Review.
The current bound of 1800s is sized for steady-state review queue but undersizes for merge landing bursts (4 interrupts on Aug 12 vs ~0.55/day baseline).
Raising DEPLOY_DEFER_MAX from 1800s (1.5x REVIEW_TIMEOUT_SECONDS) to 2400s (2.0x REVIEW_TIMEOUT_SECONDS) absorbs the observed overshoots while remaining anchored to the app's per-review timeout.
The pinned relationship test must enforce bound >= 2.0x DEFAULT_REVIEW_TIMEOUT_SECONDS to keep the deferral bound self-adjusting when REVIEW_TIMEOUT_SECONDS changes.
The 2400s raise does not fix saturated episodes where in_flight never reaches zero; it only absorbs non-saturation overshoot margins.
Terraform comment-only change; no operator apply required.
